verdict.rationale: The evidence covers Gitea's issue tracking (branches, tags, milestones, dependencies, kanban boards) and its pull request workflow. Nothing in the pack documents linking commits or pull requests to issues, or closing or updating issues from commit-message keywords. The axis clearly applies to a Git hosting service, so absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can link commits and pull requests to issues and have issue status update automatically from commit messages
